mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a fair 70 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail. Also, keep your eyes on the skies tonight as the space station will be visible starting at 5:01 PM, rising over the Northwest near Verona High School and moving toward the Northeast by Home Depot while staying low near the horizon.

For city news, please remember that city offices will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, with refuse pickup delayed until that Friday. Additionally, the city is evaluating a new public works and utilities facility to better serve our growing population.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Live music is playing at Baileys Run Vineyard today. Tomorrow, you can check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and keep an eye out for trivia nights starting at the breweries later this week.
In a noteworthy call for service, on November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day is Oreo Cookie Overload, which is a fan favorite. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and grab a scoop.
